english.meaning: works with / can be used together
english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things working together and people getting along.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when people, things, or arrangements harmonize or fit together.

examples.english: I'm quite compatible with my new colleague.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 gei2 gaap3

examples.english: These two colours are really attuned to each other.
examples.traditional: 呢兩種顏色襯埋一齊好夾。
